items.title: How many of the role's actual requirements go untested as interview slots get cut?
items.description: This role's definition names 3 required signals (incident diagnosis, stakeholder communication, code-review judgment), each mapped to its own interview slot per L3's table. The Scenario's team cut 2 of those slots under time pressure. Drag to see how directly slots cut under pressure map to requirements left with zero designed exercise behind them — this reproduces the Scenario's own numbers.

params.name: slotsCut
params.label: Interview slots cut under time pressure

items.compute: const signalsRequired = 3; const signalsUntested = Math.min(params.slotsCut, signalsRequired); return { signalsUntested };

outputs.label: Signals left with no designed exercise
